rationale: The Portal remains a presentation client and continues to admit only canonical Runtime results. It now distinguishes an evidence-backed verified non-effect from a verified execution: blocked results may carry verification.verified=true only when the Runtime supplies the registered approval-denial or governed-postcondition proof that execution_attempted was observed false. Failed actions still require verification.verified=false, approval gates still prove no execution, and arbitrary model assertions remain rejected. Informational answers may carry Runtime read-only response proof without being mislabeled as execution. This converges the client on the existing Runtime contract and does not create local classification, Authority, execution, or proof.
